results.text: It provides share price information (both in near real time and historical data) and all information published by the Group's Finance Department: press releases and news, analyst presentations, annual financial reports and registration documents from previous financial years, the financial publications calendar and the list of financial analysts that cover Elis stock. Investor relations contact Nicolas Buron Director of Investor Relations, Financing and Treasury Charline Lefaucheux Investor relations Tour Kupka A, 18 rue Hoche - F-92800 Puteaux, France investors@elis.com The provisional calendar of the main communication events coming in 2026 is as follows: Date (Tentative) 05/04/2026 Q1 2026 revenue Q2 revenue and H1 2026 results Q3 2026 revenue Financing agreements The bank financing and private placement agreements described in Note 8.3 "Gross debt" to the 2025 consolidated financial statements, which can be found in chapter 5 "Financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2025" of this Universal Registration Document, contain clauses requiring Elis to (i) comply with a financial covenant each half-year according to which the ratio of net debt as defined in the agreement to EBITDA (pro forma) after synergies (total net leverage ratio) is less than 3.75x at December 31, 2025 and on subsequent half-yearly test dates, and (ii) provide lenders with certain guarantees, in keeping with market standards, notably: a negative pledge whereby the borrower undertakes not to provide collateral to third parties, subject to certain exceptions; cross-default clauses stipulating that an event of default on any other borrowing would also render these agreements immediately due and payable; a periodic reporting obligation; compliance with legislation in force; and no change in control (resulting from the acquisition by one or more persons acting in concert of more than 50% of the voting rights in the Company). After reporting a leverage ratio, as defined in the agreements, of 1.75x at December 31, 2025, Elis is well in compliance with the covenant ratio.
